properties.title: Vinyl Chloride Fire, Near Baton Rouge,LA
properties.content: At 0930 cst on 22FEB, USCG Sector New Orleans contacted NOAA SSC about a fire at a chemical plant in Geismar, LA - a small factory town about 20 miles south of Baton Rouge. No human injuries were reported. The fire was out by the time NOAA was notified and the source was reported as secure. Several types of chlorine based chemicals were claims to be released, but nothing definitive was dtermined at the time. NOAA was consulted for plume modelling and safety concerns.

properties.title: Pipeline Release, Near Mississippi River Delta, LA
properties.content: At 2000 CST on 07MAY12, USCG Sector New Orleans contacted NOAA SSC about a pipeline release of LA sweet crude oil that occurred at 0800 the same day. The situation has stabilized and the pipeline is secure. USCG has been on scene and an OSRO has been hired by the RP. Overflight occurred at 1430 CST today and spotted a 10mi sheen moving NW along the coast. USCG has request a trajectory for sheen position at daylight tomorrow.
